meta.title: Convert.io — stop optimizing for clicks
meta.description: Your A/B tool is scoring clicks. We score revenue per visitor, and the difference is the money you are leaving on the table.

hero.headline: Your A/B test is measuring the wrong thing
hero.lede: Clicks go up, orders go flat, and the dashboard calls it a win. We score every variant on revenue per visitor instead.

cta.label: Show me what I am losing

sections.heading: Same test, two scorers
sections.sub: One of these ships the losing page.

panes.title: Scored on clicks
panes.body: The bold headline wins. It pulls 18% more clicks from the same spend.
panes.caption: Declared a winner on day three.

panes.title: Scored on revenue per visitor
panes.body: The same headline brings worse-qualified traffic. Orders per visitor fall, and so does the money.
panes.caption: Rolled back before it shipped.

sections.heading: What a finding looks like
sections.label: Sample finding
sections.now: The price appears once, below the fold, after four paragraphs of positioning.
sections.why: A visitor deciding whether to start cannot find the number that decides it, so the ones who would have paid leave to go compare.
sections.change: Move price and what it includes directly under the hero, above the fold.
sections.expected: Fewer, better-qualified starts, and a higher order rate among them.

sections.heading: Audit your page
sections.sub: One URL. Findings ranked by impact per effort, with the evidence attached.
